The first release: the official OpenCloud server, packaged as a genuine one-click Unraid app.

OpenCloud is a modern, self-hosted file sync and share platform (the actively maintained fork of ownCloud Infinite Scale). Its official image runs as a fixed non-root user with no `PUID`/`PGID` support and needs a manual one-time `init` step, so a fresh Unraid install normally fails with "permission denied". This is a thin wrapper image that fixes exactly that, and nothing else.

## What it does

- **Genuinely one-click.** Runs `opencloud init` on first boot, heals the root-owned appdata to your `PUID`/`PGID`, and starts the server. No console, no `chown`, no editing `opencloud.yaml`.
- **Permission heal.** Creates the config/data dirs and hands them to your user; a large data tree is only re-owned once (sentinel-guarded), never on every boot.
- **PUID / PGID** like every well-behaved Unraid container (default 99:100), via a static `gosu` privilege drop.
- **Two channels.** A stable `:production` tag and a fast-moving `:rolling` tag, switchable from the Unraid template. Renovate keeps both upstream base pins current.
- **Optional S3 object storage.** Point it at any S3-compatible bucket (MinIO, AWS, Backblaze B2, Wasabi) with the `decomposeds3` driver to keep file blobs in object storage; the metadata stays on the local volume.
- **No database.** OpenCloud is not Nextcloud: no MySQL/Postgres to set up. State lives in a local metadata tree plus an embedded message bus.
- **Multi-arch** — amd64 and arm64.

## Notes

- Set an Admin Password in the template before the first start; log in as user `admin`.
- Use a fresh, empty Data folder. Pointing it at an old OpenCloud/oCIS data directory (or a different storage backend) does not migrate in place.
- Behind a reverse proxy, set "OpenCloud terminates TLS" to `false` and point the proxy at the container over plain HTTP on port 9200.

## Images

- `junkerderprovinz/opencloud:production` (Docker Hub) / `ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/opencloud:production`
- `junkerderprovinz/opencloud:rolling` for the newest OpenCloud builds

The OpenCloud binary is the official upstream image (Apache-2.0); this wrapper is MIT-licensed.
